summary: Refresh tested against public preview: 20/20 API tests passed; 31/33 responsive route checks passed at 1920x800, 390x844 and 360x780. Payouts, referrals, extension settings, simulator modes, studio/moderation, insights and physical reward workflows passed. Two confirmed frontend defects remain: mobile simulator overflow and incorrect all-region ad spend. Financial/ad/extension/geographic/shipping flows are intentionally SIMULATED/MOCKED; no real integrations requested or tested.

ui_bugs.issue: 390px viewport has 480px document width; 360px has 450px. Reproduced twice. Canvas extends from -90px to viewport+90px, causing horizontal page scroll outside the map. refresh.css mobile .thunder-field width calc(100vw + 180px) is not clipped on simulator; homepage clips it correctly.

All-region Ad spend uses total views times hardcoded 0.024 instead of summing country views times country CPVV. Dataset totals 143070 views: weighted spend is $3014.802 for 7 days, but UI calculates $3433.68; 30-day UI observed $13734.72 instead of $12059.208. Selected-country spend and 4x period scaling work.

Calculate all-region spend as sum(country.views * Number(country.cpvv)) times period factor; verify country/reset/period behavior.
